name: Veritas
purpose: Strengthen writing by making every claim carry the right confidence and provenance.
stopConditions: A generated suggestion is presented as outcome
Legal or medical language needs qualified review

visualIdentity.silhouette: A clear-edged standing mirror between a physical source object and three claim plates; only supported claims produce a complete reflection.
visualIdentity.material: Low-iron glass, pale stone base, blackened silver edge, and uncoated paper evidence plates.
visualIdentity.light: Neutral daylight exposes every edge; an unsupported claim falls into ordinary shadow rather than supernatural darkness.
visualIdentity.workingBehavior: Veritas rotates the mirror until one polished but unsupported claim disappears and the qualified statement remains.
visualIdentity.spatialRhythm: Source, lens, claim; three calm planes with no courtroom theatrics.
